# argocd

Argo CD, which takes ownership of applying the cluster's manifests.

<!-- Generated by nix/floe-interface.nix. Refresh: nix run .#refresh-floe-docs -->

## Inputs

| input | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| chart | string | *(required)* | Store path of the Argo CD Helm chart. Required. |
| insecureRepo | boolean | `true` | Skip TLS verification when cloning.  True by default, and only defensible because the repository this clones is inside the same cluster: `internalUrl` is a Service address over plain HTTP, so there is no certificate to verify in the first place. A lab pointing Argo at a repository outside itself should turn this off and give it a CA.  |
| namespace | string | `"argocd"` | Namespace Argo CD runs in. |
| project | string | `"default"` | Argo project the repository is registered under. |

## Requires

| hole | signature | what it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| cluster | KUBERNETES_CLUSTER | The cluster a member installs into: its name, version, context and address ranges. |
| gateway | API_GATEWAY | An ingress a workload attaches an HTTPRoute to, and the zone its hostnames live in. |
| generation | SECRET_GENERATION | A controller that mints secret values in the cluster, so none is rendered into a manifest. |
| git | GIT_REPOSITORY | A git remote, addressed differently from inside and outside the cluster. |

| hole | signature | what it is |
